courtyard.Name: Castle Courtyard
courtyard.Description: You are standing on a paved courtyard. Towering castle walls rise above you.

throne room.Name: Throne Room
throne room.Description: A magnificent hall lit by many candlesticks.

armory.Name: Armory
armory.Description: A room filled with empty suits of armor and weapon racks.

barracks.Name: Soldiers' Barracks
barracks.Description: A row of simple wooden bunks where the castle guards rest. The air smells of old leather and sweat.

NPCs.sergeant: Keep it quiet! Some of us are trying to sleep.

training grounds.Name: Training Grounds
training grounds.Description: An open area behind the barracks with straw targets and wooden fencing.

kitchen.Name: Castle Kitchen
kitchen.Description: A hot, busy room filled with the smell of roasting meat and fresh bread.

NPCs.cook: Out of my kitchen! I'm busy preparing the feast.

cellar.Name: Wine Cellar
cellar.Description: A dark, chilly basement filled with giant wooden barrels and dusty bottles.

library.Name: Grand Library
library.Description: Floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with ancient scrolls and leather-bound books.

NPCs.scribe: Shhh! Silence is required in the hall of knowledge.

wizard tower.Name: Wizard's Tower
wizard tower.Description: The highest room in the tower. Strange blue lights flicker in the corners and an iron cauldron bubbles in the middle.

NPCs.wizard: Careful where you step. My experiments are... volatile.

dungeon.Name: Dark Dungeon
dungeon.Description: A damp, windowless prison under the castle. You can hear water dripping from the ceiling.

NPCs.prisoner: Can you spare some water, sir?
